task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three bounded product repairs: restore authored-arena spatial integrity and camera traversal, ship an accessible visual hierarchy for upgrade choices, and make dense runs lifecycle-safe and renderer-aware without replacing preserved authored assets.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate still binds gameplay framing to an occluding landmark/collision setup and lacks a qualified dense-run performance path under the available renderer; its upgrade-choice surface also needs the PRD-required visual hierarchy and accessibility treatment.

stop_conditions: Stop after the three task scopes have bounded implementation checks; host recapture, formal Tester verdicts, and issue closure remain validation responsibilities.
Do not expand into deferred ordinary-wave route work or unrelated backlog gaps.
If native renderer qualification remains unavailable, preserve the instrumentation and report the required host evidence instead of claiming a performance pass.

strategy.rationale: Keep the host-separated camera/spatial, product-shell accessibility, and dense-performance obligations as independent root-cause families. Use explicit authored-map isolation and rebinding rather than another transform-tuning pass, deliver a player-visible choice increment, and contain performance changes to measurable lifecycle-safe systems.

code: Run bounded static and parse checks for spatial integration, upgrade-choice presentation/transaction code, and dense-run lifecycle paths.
Exercise unit-level invariants for truthful choice deltas and focus navigation, collision/anchor coordinates, pool/reset counters, and renderer guard branches.
Verify preserved native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines remain intact.
runtime: Host recaptures movement_effect_capture and spatial_coordinate_probe at spawn, critical route, landmark, perimeter, and ordinary movement/movement replay states, including four cardinal first-person views from an interior native street, central-building collision/visibility, before/after extents and time-to-cross, plus real horizontal mouse yaw and vertical pitch probes with HUD mouse_filter and ？
Host recaptures page_state_probe at target resolution for the choice page, covering keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/selection states and authoritative commit/cancel receipts.

Host runs a bounded dense profile with runtime state/time and stress inputs, collecting frame-time, entity, allocation, lifecycle-reset, and renderer-capability receipts across three serial prepare/advance/reset cycles; Tester decides qualification and closes active issues.
visual: Compare shipped gameplay captures against the bound cemetery reference for expanded arena readability, external depth, stable central landmark visibility, clear escape lanes, and warm-versus-cool lighting hierarchy.
Capture the choice page showing visual hierarchy, silhouettes or icons, compact truthful current-to-new stat deltas, restrained copy, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
Inspect dense-run frames for readable automatic combat and absence of debug overlays, proxy geometry, or placeholder presentation.

done_when: The authored environment has expand/larger traversable scale with coherent external world/external depth beyond the play area, and before/after playable extents plus time-to-cross are available for recapture.

Spawn, objective anchors, navigation, and the gameplay boundary/perimeter are rebased to native authored streets; proxy floors and unrelated support geometry do not drive traversal.
Bounded spatial checks expose deterministic collision, visibility, landmark, perimeter, and movement receipts for host retest.
